عَيْثَامٌ (in the T, voce دُلْبٌ, written ↓ عَيْثَمٌ ,) A species of tree; (S, K, TA;) said to be the same as the دُلْب [q. v.]; it is a white tree, that grows very tall: n. un. with ة. (TA.) ＝
-A2- Also A certain sort of food, in which locusts are cooked; (K, TA;) of the food of the people of the desert. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
